12/8 to swing: a notation test

RS200 writes slow triplet-feel songs in 12/8, which is exact for a machine and hard for a person to read. Here each one is "played" into Chord Entry's live take reader at its real tempo, each dotted-quarter beat becoming a quarter-note beat, and read in 4/4 with swing on, triplets on auto and sixteenths allowed. The other cards are the take's own DWIM readings, ranked by its cost score (lower is plainer; each dropped note costs a lot). The 4/4 versions play back swung.
